dialogues.speaker: Jahan
dialogues.text: A combination of abundant sunshine, plenty of rain, and the Anahitian Blessing will guarantee a good harvest.

dialogues.speaker: Jahan
dialogues.text: What, you never heard of the Anahitian Blessing?

dialogues.speaker: Jahan
dialogues.text: It's practically essential to growing crops, and it's not an overstatement to say it's our savior.

dialogues.speaker: Jahan
dialogues.text: Oh wait, I should say the Dendro Archon is our savior, since the Blessing is a gift from her.

dialogues.speaker: Jahan
dialogues.text: O Greater Lord Rukkhadevata, O Dendro Archon, may you grant us bountiful harvest!

dialogues.speaker: Jahan
dialogues.text: I hope everything will be timely.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me more about the Anahitian Blessing...

dialogues.speaker: Jahan
dialogues.text: Hmmm? Have you never heard of the Anahitian Blessing?

dialogues.speaker: Jahan
dialogues.text: It's practically essential to growing crops, and it's not an overstatement to say that it's been our savior.

dialogues.speaker: Jahan
dialogues.text: Oh wait, I should say that the Dendro Archon is our savior, since the Blessing is her gift to us.

dialogues.speaker: Jahan
dialogues.text: Oh great Dendro Archon, may our upcoming harvests be bountiful ones also?
